items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I started playing, and I liked the way she sang...

ctx.x: Singer and vocalist. Every bar-and-grill had a back room where people sat down, and you had a piano player and a singer. So Monette Moore was in one of these... I forget... Was it the Alhambra? There were so many of them up in Harlem. And they were very popular, and they all had, you know, their own style of singing. I started playing, and I liked the way she sang...
She was quite popular at that time, too, wasn't she?
